body: Addressed in bc16ccff3601fabeeb783f41b52360ef5851838a: Get-PxcGateway now verifies applicable TCP LISTEN ownership against the already validated process before returning the fixed HTTP endpoint. Denied, malformed, mismatched and conflicting records fail closed. Native PS5.1/7 tests reproduce the old wrong-owner dummy-key wire leak and pass the new positive/negative controls. Independent exact-head review3 verified the entire finding class closed: https://github.com/ducthangho/tra-luat/issues/1279#issuecomment-6720089491 . Snapshot/query-to-send race limits remain explicit; no atomic ownership claim or real deployment activation.
